title: expose-lazy-attrs-in-dir
request: dir() on browser_use.integrations.toolsets_for_claude doesn't list Bash and BrowserUse because they're lazy-loaded. Can we make dir() include those names?
reference_diff:
--- a/browser_use/integrations/toolsets_for_claude/__init__.py
+++ b/browser_use/integrations/toolsets_for_claude/__init__.py
@@ -18,3 +18,7 @@
 	value = getattr(anthropic, name)
 	globals()[name] = value
 	return value
+
+def __dir__():
+    """Return module attributes for dir(). Includes lazily loaded names."""
+    return sorted(list(globals().keys()) + __all__)
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/ci/test_toolsets_dir.py
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+import importlib
+
+def test_dir_contains_lazy_attrs():
+    ts = importlib.import_module('browser_use.integrations.toolsets_for_claude')
+    attrs = dir(ts)
+    assert 'BrowserUse' in attrs, 'BrowserUse should appear in dir() after lazy import support'
+    assert 'Bash' in attrs, 'Bash should appear in dir() after lazy import support'
